mapper.update: UPDATE agent_subagent_task SET callback_status='REGISTERED',callback_owner=NULL,callback_claimed_at=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND callback_status='DELIVERING' AND callback_owner=#{callbackOwner} AND status IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELLED') AND deleted=0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_parent_resume_request (tenant_id,user_id,parent_run_id,parent_session_id,parent_agent_id,trace_id,status,requested_version, processed_version,inbox_cursor,fencing_token,attempt_count,next_attempt_at,created_at,updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId},#{userId},#{parentRunId},#{parentSessionId},#{parentAgentId},#{traceId},'PENDING',1, 0,0,0,0,#{nextAttemptAt},NOW(3),NOW(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE requested_version=requested_version+1, status=IF(status='RUNNING','RUNNING','PENDING'), next_attempt_at=VALUES(next_attempt_at), user_id=VALUES(user_id),parent_session_id=VALUES(parent_session_id),parent_agent_id=VALUES(parent_agent_id), trace_id=VALUES(trace_id),updated_at=NOW(3)
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_parent_resume_request SET status='RUNNING',lease_owner=#{workerId},lease_expires_at=#{leaseExpiresAt}, fencing_token=fencing_token+1,attempt_count=attempt_count+1,recovery_notified_at=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND parent_run_id=#{parentRunId} AND deleted=0 AND ((status IN ('PENDING','RETRYING') AND next_attempt_at <= #{now}) OR (status='RUNNING' AND lease_expires_at < #{now}))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM agent_parent_resume_request WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND parent_run_id=#{parentRunId} AND status='RUNNING' AND lease_owner=#{workerId} AND deleted=0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_subagent_task SET status='ACKED',acknowledged_at=#{deliveredAt},callback_status='DELIVERED', callback_delivered_at=#{deliveredAt},callback_owner=NULL,callback_claimed_at=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND parent_run_id=#{parentRunId} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND status IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELLED') AND callback_status='REGISTERED' AND deleted=0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM agent_parent_resume_request WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND parent_run_id=#{parentRunId} AND deleted=0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_parent_resume_request SET status='RETRYING',next_attempt_at=#{nextAttemptAt}, last_error=#{lastError},lease_owner=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND parent_run_id=#{parentRunId} AND status='RUNNING' AND lease_owner=#{workerId} AND fencing_token=#{fencingToken} AND deleted=0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM agent_parent_resume_request WHERE deleted=0 AND ((status IN ('PENDING','RETRYING') AND next_attempt_at <= #{now}) OR (status='RUNNING' AND lease_expires_at < #{now})) AND (recovery_notified_at IS NULL OR recovery_notified_at < #{staleBefore}) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
